title: NMR receive coil former
blurb: The receiver's noise budget rests on one number: 2.53 mH sets the resonating capacitor, the tank's parallel resistance and so the 15.3 nV/rtHz floor, and it is what puts the OPA1656 and OPA1612 on opposite sides of their crossover impedance. Hand-wind twice and none of that describes the bench. A 38.5 x 2.7 mm winding window gives 546 turns and 2.52 mH. A single layer cannot reach it: 2900 turns, 1.2 m long.
